# Killer Whale (`monsters:killer-whale`)

**AC** 12 | **HP** 90 (12d12 + 12) | **Speed** 5 ft., swim 60 ft.
**STR** 19 (+4) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 13 (+1) | **INT** 3 (-4) | **WIS** 12 (+1) | **CHA** 7 (-2)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +3, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +4
**Senses:** Blindsight 120 ft., Passive Perception 13
**Languages:** None

## Traits
